design.purpose: A drained outdoor planter for one person to grow herbs or flowers; finished box holds soil about 18 cm deep.

steps.c: Place the 120 cm wide board flat for cutting.
Cut a 40 cm base; keep the 79.7 cm offcut.
Place the 120 cm board flat for cutting.
Cut 40, 40, 16 and 16 cm parts; keep offcut.
Place the 120 cm narrow board flat for cutting.
Cut two 20 cm feet; keep the 79.4 cm offcut.
Sand cut edges of the base smooth.
Sand cut edges of front and back smooth.
Sand cut edges of both ends smooth.
Sand cut edges of both feet smooth.
Drill five drainage holes through the base.
Place the 40 cm base flat.
Stand the front side on the base front edge.
Stand the back side on the base back edge.
Fit the first end between the sides.
Fit the second end between the sides.
Drive 2 screws through the front
Drive 2 screws through the front
Drive 2 screws through the back
Drive 2 screws through the back
Drive 2 screws through the base
Drive 2 screws through the base
Place first foot under the base near one end.
Place second foot under the base near other end.
Drive 2 screws through the foot
Drive 2 screws through the foot
